goal.zh: 先出馬象，再鞏固中央與入堡。
goal.en: Develop the knight and bishop, secure the center, then castle.

steps.zh: 兵佔中心，同時打開后和白格象的路。
steps.en: Takes the center and opens lines for the queen and the light-squared bishop.

steps.zh: 看 e5 的黑兵：它控制 d4、f4，與 e4 的白兵隔格相對。兩邊的 d 兵若往前推，都會碰到對方中心兵的壓力。
steps.en: The pawn on e5 controls d4 and f4, facing the white pawn on e4. Advancing either d-pawn challenges the opposing central pawn.

steps.zh: 出馬，同時攻擊 e5 兵。
steps.en: Develops a knight and attacks the e5 pawn.

steps.zh: 白馬剛走到 f3，已經攻擊 e5。黑馬從 b8 到 c6，現在也守著 e5；看兩隻馬都指向同一個中心兵。
steps.en: The white knight on f3 attacks e5. By developing from b8 to c6, Black adds a defender to that pawn; both knights now point at e5.

steps.zh: 象瞄準 f7 —— 黑方王旁邊只有王在守的那一格。
steps.en: The bishop aims at f7 — the square next to Black's king that only the king defends.

steps.zh: 沿著 c5–d4–e3–f2 看，黑象的斜線通向白王旁的 f2 兵。雙方的象現在都朝對方王翼看，白方接著要兼顧中心與王的安全。
steps.en: Follow c5–d4–e3–f2: the black bishop points at the pawn beside White’s king. Both bishops now face the opposing king side, so White must consider the center and king safety.

steps.zh: 準備之後推 d4 佔中心，也讓后之後有 b3 這一格可以去。
steps.en: Prepares d4 to take the center and gives the queen the b3 square later.

steps.zh: 黑方出馬，攻擊 e4 兵。
steps.en: Black develops and attacks the e4 pawn.

steps.zh: 用兵守住 e4，同時打開 c1 象的路。先把子出完，不急著推 d4。
steps.en: Defends e4 with a pawn and opens the c1 bishop. Finish developing before pushing d4.

steps.zh: 黑方用兵守 e5，打開 c8 象的路。
steps.en: Black defends e5 and opens the c8 bishop.

steps.zh: 入堡：王離開中間，車往中間靠。
steps.en: Castles: the king leaves the center and the rook moves toward it.

steps.zh: 黑王從 e8 到 g8，h8 的車到 f8。對照上一張圖，雙方的王都離開了 e 線；接著可以把車調到中心兵後方。
steps.en: The black king moves from e8 to g8 and the rook from h8 to f8. Both kings have now left the e-file, allowing the rooks to support the central pawns.

steps.zh: 車到 e 線支援 e4，之後馬可以走 d2、f1、g3 這條路線。
steps.en: The rook supports e4 from the e-file; later the knight can travel d2–f1–g3.

steps.zh: 黑方準備 …b5 趕 c4 的象。現在直接走 …b5 會被 Bxb5 白吃；先走 a6，b5 就有兵保護。象之後退到 a7，也不會被 b4 追著打。
steps.en: Black prepares …b5 to chase the c4 bishop. Played now, …b5 just loses a pawn to Bxb5; after a6 the b5 pawn is protected. It also gives the bishop a7, where b4 cannot harass it.

steps.zh: 先把象退到 b3，避開 …b5 的追趕，也保留瞄準 f7 的斜線。
steps.en: Retreats to b3 ahead of …b5 and keeps the diagonal toward f7.

steps.zh: 黑方也把象退到安全的斜線上。
steps.en: Black also tucks the bishop onto a safe diagonal.

steps.zh: 不讓黑方 …Bg4 牽制 f3 的馬。
steps.en: Stops …Bg4 pinning the knight on f3.

steps.zh: 黑方同樣防止 Bg5 的牽制。
steps.en: Black likewise prevents the Bg5 pin.

steps.zh: 最後一個馬出動，之後走 f1、g3 加入王翼。
steps.en: The last knight comes out, heading to f1 and g3 to join the king side.

goal.zh: 先出馬象，再鞏固中央與入堡。
goal.en: Develop the knight and bishop, secure the center, then castle.

steps.zh: 同樣用兵佔中心，不讓白方一個人獨佔。
steps.en: Claims the center too so White does not have it alone.

steps.zh: 出象，同樣瞄準白方的 f2。
steps.en: Develops the bishop, aiming at White's f2 in the same way.

steps.zh: 出馬攻擊 e4，也準備入堡。
steps.en: Develops, attacks e4 and prepares to castle.

steps.zh: 用兵守 e5，同時打開 c8 象的路。
steps.en: Defends e5 and opens the c8 bishop.
Castles: the king leaves the center.
White puts the rook on the e-file.

steps.zh: 給象留一條退路：白方推 b4 時，象可以退到 a7，不會被追著打。
steps.en: Gives the bishop a retreat: if White plays b4, it drops to a7 instead of being chased.

steps.zh: 象退到 a7，繼續瞄準 f2。
steps.en: The bishop retreats to a7 and keeps aiming at f2.

steps.zh: 同樣不讓白方 Bg5 牽制 f6 的馬。
steps.en: Likewise stops Bg5 pinning the f6 knight.

steps.zh: 車到 e 線保護 e5，形狀擺完了。
steps.en: The rook comes to the e-file to protect e5; the setup is complete.

goal.zh: 先讓黑格象出來，再建立 e3、c3 的兵鏈。
goal.en: Develop the dark-squared bishop before building the e3–c3 pawn chain.

steps.zh: 兵佔中心，打開 c1 象的路。
steps.en: Takes the center and opens the c1 bishop.

steps.zh: 先把象出到 f4。這一步要在 e3 之前，不然 e3 會把象關在裡面。
steps.en: Bishop out to f4 first. It must come before e3, or e3 locks it in.

steps.zh: 用兵支撐 d4，也打開 f1 象的路。
steps.en: Supports d4 and opens the f1 bishop.

steps.zh: 黑方打開 f8 象的路。

steps.en: Black challenges d4 from the side.

steps.zh: c3、d4、e3 三個兵連成一線，d4 很穩，吃掉也有兵補回來。
steps.en: Pawns on c3, d4 and e3 form a chain; d4 is solid and can be recaptured by a pawn.

steps.zh: 黑方出馬，再加一個子攻擊 d4。
steps.en: Black develops and adds another attacker on d4.

steps.zh: 出馬，留在 d2 不擋 c3 兵，之後可以支援 e4。
steps.en: Develops to d2, leaving c3 free and preparing to support e4.

steps.zh: 黑方想用自己的象換掉 f4 這隻好象。
steps.en: Black wants to trade off the strong bishop on f4.

steps.zh: 退到 g3，不讓黑方換得太舒服；如果黑方換，hxg3 之後 h 線打開。
steps.en: Drops back to g3; if Black trades, hxg3 opens the h-file.

steps.zh: 白格象到最好的斜線，瞄準黑方王前的 h7。
steps.en: The light-squared bishop takes its best diagonal, aiming at h7 in front of Black's king.

steps.zh: 黑方準備把 c8 象從 b7 出動。
steps.en: Black prepares to develop the c8 bishop via b7.

steps.zh: 后讓開，兩個車連起來，之後可以推 e4 或跳 Ne5。
steps.en: The queen steps aside to connect the rooks, preparing e4 or Ne5.

goal.zh: 用 d4 打開中央，吃回兵後處理馬的壓力。
goal.en: Open the center with d4 and meet the pressure on the knight after recapturing.

steps.zh: 馬上用第二個兵挑戰中心，逼黑方做決定。
steps.en: Challenges the center with a second pawn right away and forces Black to decide.

steps.zh: 用馬吃回來，馬站在中心。
steps.en: Recaptures with the knight, which now stands in the center.

steps.zh: 黑方牽制 c3 的馬 —— 那是守 e4 的子。
steps.en: Black pins the c3 knight — the piece defending e4.

steps.zh: 換掉 c6 的馬，黑方用 b 兵吃回來，c 線會有兩個疊兵。
steps.en: Trades on c6; Black recaptures with the b-pawn and gets doubled c-pawns.

steps.zh: 出象，同時再保護一次 e4。
steps.en: Develops the bishop and adds another defender to e4.
Black challenges e4 with a pawn.

steps.zh: e4 被 d5 攻擊，而 c3 的馬被牽制在王前面、不能去守，所以先換掉。
steps.en: d5 attacks e4, and the c3 knight is pinned to the king and cannot defend it, so trade first.

steps.zh: 黑方吃回來，疊兵消掉一個。
steps.en: Black recaptures and undoubles one pawn.

steps.zh: 入堡，王安全，車準備出動。
steps.en: Castles: the king is safe and the rook is ready.

steps.zh: 出最後一個輕子，牽制 f6 的馬。
steps.en: Develops the last minor piece and pins the f6 knight.

variants.en: …Nf6: defend e4 with the other knight

goal.zh: 先用 Nc3 守 e4，再自然出子與入堡。
goal.en: Defend e4 with Nc3 before developing naturally and castling.

steps.zh: 佔住 e4，打開后與象的路。
steps.en: Take e4 and open lines for the queen and bishop.
The knight defends e4 and controls d5.
The bishop points along the diagonal toward f7.

steps.zh: 用兵守 e4，讓 c1 象有路。
steps.en: Defend e4 and open the c1 bishop.
Black develops the bishop to c5.
Develop the knight and prepare to castle.

steps.zh: 王離開中央，車靠近 e 線。
steps.en: Move the king away from the center and connect the rook to the center.
Develop the bishop to e3 to support the center.

steps.zh: 黑象退到 b6 保留斜線。
steps.en: Black preserves the bishop’s diagonal from b6.

steps.zh: 后接到 d2，讓車將來能連接。
steps.en: Place the queen on d2 to help connect the rooks.

steps.zh: 黑方也讓 c8 象出來。
象退到 b3 保留壓力。
steps.en: Retreat the bishop to b3 while keeping its diagonal.

steps.zh: 黑后離開底線連接雙車。
steps.en: Black moves the queen off the back rank to connect the rooks.

steps.zh: 馬進到 d5 中央前哨。

variants.en: Bishop to b4: meet the pressure

goal.zh: 用 c4 挑戰 d5，辨認接受與拒絕棄兵的差別。
goal.en: Challenge d5 with c4 and distinguish accepted and declined structures.

steps.en: Claim central space with a pawn.

steps.zh: 黑方建立 d5 支點。
steps.en: Black establishes a pawn on d5.

steps.zh: 用 c 兵挑戰 d5。
黑方用 e 兵支撐 d5。
steps.en: Black supports d5 with the e-pawn.

steps.zh: 出馬增加對 d5 的壓力。
steps.en: Develop and add pressure to d5.

steps.zh: 象釘住 f6 馬與后之間的斜線。
steps.en: The bishop pins the f6 knight along the diagonal to the queen.

steps.zh: 黑象解除這條斜線上的牽制。
steps.en: Black’s bishop breaks that pin on the diagonal.
Open the light-squared bishop and support d4.

steps.zh: 出馬控制 e5，準備入堡。
steps.en: Develop toward e5 and prepare to castle.

steps.zh: 車放到可能打開的 c 線。
steps.en: Place the rook on the potentially open c-file.
Develop the bishop to d3 and prepare to castle.
Recapture the c4 pawn with the bishop.

steps.zh: 黑馬進到 d5 擋住斜線。
steps.en: Black centralizes the knight on d5 and blocks the diagonal.

variants.zh: 接受棄兵：準備拿回 c4

goal.zh: 直接挑戰 e4，后被出馬攻擊時退到 a5。
goal.en: Challenge e4 immediately and retreat the queen to a5 when developed against.

steps.zh: 白方用 e4 佔中央。
steps.en: White claims the center with e4.
Recapture the central pawn with the queen.
White develops with an attack on the queen.

steps.zh: 后退到 a5，離開馬的攻擊。
steps.en: Retreat to a5, out of the knight’s attack.

steps.zh: 出馬控制 e4 與 d5。
steps.en: Develop the knight toward e4 and d5.

steps.zh: 用 c6 支撐 d5，讓后能沿斜線撤回。
steps.en: Support d5 with c6 and open a diagonal retreat for the queen.
Develop the light-squared bishop before considering …e6.

steps.zh: 打開 f8 象並支撐中央。
steps.en: Open the f8 bishop and support the center.
White centralizes the knight on e5.

steps.zh: 出另一匹馬，保護 f6 馬。
steps.en: Develop the other knight and support the knight on f6.
White exchanges the knight on d7.
White places the rook on the e-file.

steps.zh: 后翼入堡，車接到 d 線。
steps.en: Castle queenside and place the rook on the d-file.

variants.en: Queen to d6: cover the center

goal.zh: 用 c6 支撐 d5，讓白格象先走出兵鏈。
goal.en: Support d5 with c6 and develop the light-squared bishop outside the pawn chain.

steps.en: White occupies the center with two pawns.

steps.zh: 在 c6 兵支援下推 …d5。
交換掉 e4 的中央兵。
象出到兵鏈外，攻擊 e4 馬。
steps.en: Develop the bishop outside the pawn chain, attacking the e4 knight.
White moves the knight away and attacks the bishop.

steps.zh: 白兵準備 h5 追象。
steps.en: White prepares h5 to chase the bishop.

steps.zh: 留出 h7 退路，應對 h5。
steps.en: Make h7 available for the bishop against h5.
Develop the other knight toward f6.

steps.zh: 利用先前留下的 h7 退路。
steps.en: Use the h7 retreat prepared earlier.

steps.zh: 白象出到 d3，提出交換。
steps.en: White develops to d3 and offers a bishop exchange.

steps.zh: 用 e6 開啟黑格象的路。
steps.en: Open the dark-squared bishop with e6.

goal.zh: 用 c6 支撐 d5，讓白格象先走出兵鏈。
goal.en: Support d5 with c6 and develop the light-squared bishop outside the pawn chain.

steps.en: White occupies the center with two pawns.

steps.en: Open the dark-squared bishop with e6.

goal.zh: 建立 e6、d5 兵鏈，再用 …c5 攻擊白方 d4。
goal.en: Build the e6–d5 chain, then challenge d4 with …c5.

steps.zh: 挑戰 e4，形成中央接觸。
steps.en: Challenge e4 and create central tension.
White advances to form a pawn chain.
Attack the base of the chain on d4.

steps.zh: 白方用 c3 守 d4。

steps.en: Develop and add pressure to d4.
